5 تثوّلت النَّحْلُ The bees collected themselves together, and became dense. (M, K.) See also 7. ―
-b2- تثوّل عَلَيْهِ He, (a man, TA,) or they, (a company of men, S, M,) assailed him, or overcame him, with reviling (S, M, K) and beating (S, M) and oppressive conduct; (M, K;) as also ↓ انثال . (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
